member.name: T:Microsoft.Samples.SqlServer.LargeObjectBinary
member.summary: Date: May 22, 2004 Purpose: The purpose of this sample is to show: 1) how to read binary data from a file and store the contents into a database 2) how to retrieve binary data stored in the database and write the contents to a file This version of the sample is designed to run server side. Note that in Yukon Beta 1, VARBINARY(MAX) only supports 8000 bytes of data from CLR stored procedures. Any additional data will be silently truncated. Connects to a database and contains the methods for reading and writing large binary objects to and from the database.
